Net 0 bytes: take_off+1.. and put_on and everything after stay at their addresses. Alternatives: candidates 2, 3, 4 are subsets or variants (overlap).
candidates.equivalence: (1) The y1 and y2 updates touch different arrays and only A/flags between them; exit state A,X,Y,C is dead after widen_by_live's RTS (annotation out:-; caller falls to .listed INC list_n then LDY ren_k, no use of A/X/C). y1: original stores when list_y1[MS] < list_y1[X] (BCS skips when >=); new BCC stores exactly then, A still holds the value. y2 block is unchanged text moved first. (2) the three BCC no are taken only with C=0, so CLC was a no-op; the fall-through path still ends with C from the final CMP; callers (render.6502:1117, sky_off.6502:77) read C only. (3) BPL out when need,X bit7 clear becomes RTS directly, bit7 set falls into the unchanged rest; BEQ out later still targets .out (RTS). No entries past labels: grep take_off+/widen_by_live+/list_overlap+ finds none; take_off.out is not referenced elsewhere.
candidates.relies_on: Code size net 0 after take_off's first line (widen +1, list_overlap -2, take_off +1) so put_on and later branch/page positions are exactly as now; only code between 9931 and 9975 moves, whose branches (x2/y kept, no, out, each within page &99) stay in-page and have no indexed code reads.
